verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a Management API for uploading fine-tuned models from an S3 bucket, tracking versions, and deploying them to a dedicated endpoint, where they run alongside standard model variants. That directly covers uploading and serving custom weights. The capability is documented only for dedicated (private, provisioned) endpoints, not the public self-serve tier. missing for 10: documentation of LoRA adapter support specifically, supported architectures and formats, availability outside dedicated endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters

citations.quote: Upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to your [dedicated endpoint](/dedicated/overview).
Deploy your custom fine-tuned models alongside standard model variants.
